name: U2Code Product Addons for WooCommerce
author: Mykola Lukin

sections.description:
U2Code Product Addons lets customers personalize the products they buy — engraving text, gift wrap, image swatches, uploaded artwork, donations — and charges for it right on the product page, with a live totals box that updates as they pick.

Build addon groups once and attach them to your whole catalog, to specific products, categories, tags or brands, or add fields to a single product from its own edit screen. No code, no shortcodes.

Try the live demo — the builder and the storefront, ready to click through.

Field types

  • Multiple Choice — dropdown (single, or multi-select with tags and search), radio buttons, checkboxes, toggle switches, buttons, pills, cards, or image and color swatches (square or circle), with option images, descriptions and 1 to 4 options per row
  • Single Checkbox — gift wrap, express handling, an agreement to accept, shown as a checkbox, a switch or a card
  • Short Text — plain text, number, email, phone or URL, with optional character limits
  • Long Text — multi-line input for gift messages and instructions
  • Quantity — a numeric amount priced per unit, as a number box, a stepper or a slider
  • Date Picker — delivery and pickup dates, with selectable range limits
  • File Upload — artwork, photos and documents, with file type and size limits
  • Customer Defined Price — donations, tips, “pay what you want”
  • Heading — display-only text to structure long forms

Pricing

Charge a flat fee, a percentage of the product price, per quantity, or per character of what the customer types. Every price shows in a live totals box before add to cart and carries through the cart, checkout, order emails and the admin order screen.

Targeting

  • Assign addon groups to all products, or target specific products, categories, tags and brands — with exclusions
  • Show fields only for selected variations of a variable product
  • Reusable option sets, or import options straight from a product attribute

Design

Four storefront themes — Boxed, Compact, Bold and Soft — previewed live in the settings, or switch styling off entirely and use your theme’s own look. All markup uses plain, prefixed CSS classes that are easy to override.

Fits into your store

  • Classic and block-based (Store API) cart and checkout
  • Customers can reopen and edit their choices from the cart; you can edit them on the order from the admin
  • Uploaded files are private: they open only for your staff and the customer who uploaded them, and files never attached to an order are cleaned up automatically
  • Multi-currency: WOOCS, CURCY, Aelia, WCML, WooPayments and Currency Switcher for WooCommerce
  • WPML and Polylang, including targeting translated products
  • Works alongside Tiered Pricing Table — addons stack correctly on tier prices
  • HPOS compatible

Pro version

The paid version adds features for stores that need more:

  • Date Range field — a start and end date priced per day, for rentals and hire periods
  • Dimensions field — width × height priced by area, for made-to-measure blinds, glass, fabric and signage
  • Users & Roles — show addon groups only to certain roles or specific customers, or hide them from some
  • Multiple file uploads on a single File Upload field
  • Selection limits — require a minimum and maximum number of choices on multi-select fields
  • Conditional logic — show or hide any field based on what the customer picked in another, with unlimited rules

Upgrade from the Product Addons screen inside the plugin.

Source code & build

The admin app in assets/admin/ is compiled with webpack. Its human-readable
source ships in this plugin under js-source/. To rebuild it:

  1. cd js-source
  2. npm install
  3. npm run build

The output is written to assets/admin/. Everything else in assets/ is
hand-written and used as-is.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/u2code-product-addons-for-woocommerce, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  3. Go to Products → Addons to create your first addon group, or open the Product Addons tab on any product to add product-specific fields.
sections.faq:
Do addons work with variable products?

Yes. Fields render above the variations table, and individual fields can be limited to selected variations so they appear only after a matching variation is chosen.

Do addons work with the block-based cart and checkout?

Yes. Selections show on cart lines in both the classic and block-based cart. Products with file-upload fields still need the classic product page form, since files cannot travel in a Store API request.

Can customers edit their choices from the cart?

Yes — an “Edit options” link on the cart line reopens the product page with everything prefilled, including the quantity.

Where do uploaded customer files go?

Each file goes into its own randomly named folder inside your uploads folder, which refuses direct requests; the order screen and e-mails link to a download that opens only for your staff and the customer. Files not attached to any order are deleted automatically after a configurable number of days (WooCommerce → Settings → Products → Product Addons).

Will it slow my store down?

The storefront loads one small script and stylesheet, only on pages that actually show addons. The admin builder is a separate app that never loads on the storefront.

Does deleting the plugin remove my data?

Only if you ask it to. Addon groups, settings and uploads are removed on uninstall only when you opt in to cleanup; otherwise everything is kept for reinstalling later.
sections.changelog:
1.2.2 – 2026-11-27

  • New: compatibility with Tax Switch for WooCommerce: option prices and the product page totals follow the incl./excl. VAT switch.
  • Fix: option prices in dropdowns no longer show two amounts side by side when Tax Switch for WooCommerce is active.
  • Fix: switches, cards, buttons and swatches lost their layout on block themes that load WooCommerce’s layout styles.

1.2.1 – 2026-11-24

  • Improvement: in the free version, the Conditional logic setting shows the premium note only when you tick it, without a Premium badge.

1.2.0 – 2026-11-24

  • New: option images beside the label in lists, buttons, cards and the multi-select.
  • New: options per row (1 to 4) for lists, buttons, cards and swatches.
  • New: option descriptions, a line of text under each option.
  • New: the multi-select dropdown can show picked options as removable tags and add a search box.
  • New: Toggle Switches display for Multiple Choice.
  • New: Switch and Card styles for the Single Checkbox.
  • New: stepper and slider styles for Quantity and number fields.
  • Fix: cards, buttons, swatches and the single checkbox lost their layout in Storefront and other themes that style form labels as blocks.

1.1.4 – 2026-11-23

  • New: price breakdown in the cart (setting): the item price, each option and the item total under every cart item, with options charged once per item shown on their own.
  • New: option to show the product price in the product page totals.
  • Fix: an option charged once per item could make the cart total a few cents off.
  • Fix: editing an order’s options charged the wrong amount when prices are entered including tax.

1.1.3 – 2026-11-22

  • New: translations in 10 languages: Arabic, Chinese, Dutch, French, German (also formal), Italian, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian and Spanish.
  • New: placeholder text for dropdown fields.

1.1.2 – 2026-11-22

  • New: Date Picker limits: earliest and latest date (fixed or in days from today), closed weekdays and unavailable dates, checked on add to cart.
  • Fix: uploaded files can no longer be opened by anyone with the link; they open for the store’s staff and the customer who uploaded them.
  • Fix: the Edit options link stays on the block cart after a quantity change.
  • Fix: the block cart shows the Edit options link for addon groups that place it under the product name.
  • Fix: Edit options on a variable product’s cart line keeps the chosen variation.

1.1.0 – 2026-11-11

  • New: product exclusions: keep an addon group off chosen products, categories, tags or brands.
  • Improvement: the addon editor’s sidebar scrolls on its own, so every panel stays reachable.
  • Improvement: Freemius SDK 2.13.5.
  • Fix: Edit addons on an order placed at the checkout no longer charges the addons a second time.
  • Fix: a field’s error message disappears as soon as the customer corrects the field.

1.0.1 – 2026-09-10

  • New: a Multiple Choice field set to Dropdown with “Allow multiple selections” now renders as a compact multi-select — a dropdown-sized box that opens a checkbox list — instead of switching to checkboxes.

1.0.0 – 2026-08-18

  • Initial release.
